title: Break To Build
tagline: Thirty founders. Thirty ad films. Zero shoots.
summary: A 100% AI experiment in making a TVC: founders photographed once, then broken, bent and built into cinematic films.

sections.label: The brief
sections.title: Back the founders building India, on the biggest stage in Indian marketing.
sections.body: Razorpay's IPL 2026 push on JioHotstar. The ambition was to match the scale and spectacle of the tournament, while also stress-testing everything the design team had learned about AI workflows, tooling and design systems over the year.

sections.text: A 100% AI experiment in making a TVC. No actors. No stunts. No live-action shots.

sections.label: The launch film
sections.title: What if breaking through was literal?
sections.body: We took the campaign idea of breaking through and turned it into a visual statement: breaking, bending and defying the impossible.

sections.label: The problem
sections.title: Getting 30 busy founders in one frame? Almost impossible.
sections.body:
A shoot at this scale means complex schedules and a massive production budget. Breaking glass, breaking walls, breaking ceilings means high-risk shots, high production costs, and founders who are not actors.

**AI made it possible. Thirty founders. One frame. Zero logistics.**

sections.label: From a photoshoot to a TV commercial
sections.title: One shoot and AI. Infinite possibilities.

items.title: Shoot
items.body: Founders photographed once across carefully planned angles and poses.

items.title: Style frames
items.body: We designed the visual language and built the worlds each founder would break through.

items.title: Generate
items.body: AI transformed stills into cinematic environments, action and destruction.

items.title: Craft
items.body: Shots were refined, composited and edited into finished films.

sections.caption: From internal shoot, to planned poses, to worlds, to finished films

sections.label: The takeaway
sections.title: A stress test for everything the team had learned about AI.
sections.body: Thirty ad films, a launch film, teasers, music and supporting content, produced AI-led from end to end: not AI-assisted, not AI-enhanced. It took collective conviction to say yes to something with no established playbook, on one of the biggest stages in Indian marketing.
